guard/30072.htm.text: Guard Metty: Ahh... What is it?! Can't you see I'm on duty? This soldier has no time to chatter leisurely with the likes of you, country wanderer. Don't be a nuisance. Do me a favor and disappear from my sight. Hey, country bumpkin! There is a village that suits the likes of you. If you follow this…

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

guard/30072-1.htm.text: Guard Metty: You really are a bother. You want to know about that place in detail? Haven't you heard what I've said? Are you deaf? If you are that curious, go see it with your own two eyes! And don't annoy my exalted self any more!

Q00419_GetAPet/30072-01.html.text: Guard Metty: Yes, I am a member of the animal lover's association. Why did you want to see me? I am very busy. Speak up!

Q00419_GetAPet/30072-02.html.text: Guard Metty: So, you want to learn about pets? I'll tell you everything I know. First of all, the wolf. This is the first pet that you will breed.
